title: Schedule of Refundability, Cancellation Charges and the Annexed Penalty Ladder — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Whether an unflown ticket can be refunded at all or is only forfeited, the form in which value is returned on cancellation, the business days the settlement of an approved refund takes, the flat cancellation penalty withheld from the value returned, the penalty charged where the traveller neither flies nor cancels before departure, and the hours before departure by which a cancellation must be confirmed for the fare's refund terms to apply are fixed by the fare brand held. This schedule states them for the seven brands sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands.

| Fare brand | Unflown ticket refundable | Form value is returned in | Settlement of an approved refund, business days | Flat cancellation penalty, USD | Penalty where the traveller neither flies nor cancels, USD | Cancellation to be confirmed before departure, hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | not refundable | no value returned | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Economy Saver | not refundable | travel credit | 14 | 149.00 | 225.00 | 2 |
| Economy Classic | not refundable | travel credit | 14 | 119.00 | 195.00 | 2 |
| Economy Flex | refundable | the original form of payment | 10 | 89.00 | 150.00 | 2 |
| Premium Economy Select | refundable | the original form of payment | 10 | 79.00 | 125.00 | 3 |
| Business Saver | refundable | the original form of payment | 7 | 59.00 | 100.00 | 3 |
| Business Flex | refundable | the original form of payment | 5 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4 |

Annexe: the ladder of cancellation penalty figures each brand's tariff holds, keyed by how far ahead of departure a cancellation is confirmed.

| Fare brand | 60 or more days before departure, USD | 59 to 15 days before departure, USD | 14 to 3 days before departure, USD | 2 or fewer days before departure, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | 89.00 | 129.00 | 149.00 | 189.00 |
| Economy Classic | 69.00 | 99.00 | 119.00 | 159.00 |
| Economy Flex | 49.00 | 69.00 | 89.00 | 119.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | 39.00 | 59.00 | 79.00 | 99.00 |
| Business Saver | 0.00 | 39.00 | 59.00 | 79.00 |
| Business Flex | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

Notes to the lines.

1. Basic Economy Lite and Business Flex stand at 0.00 on every rung of the annexed ladder, the first because nothing is returned under it and the second because no cancellation penalty is withheld from it. Business Saver stands at 0.00 only on the rung of 60 or more days before departure and rises to 39.00, then 59.00, then 79.00 as departure approaches.

2. The deadline line is the hours before departure by which the cancellation must be confirmed for the fare's refund terms to apply. Under Business Flex a cancellation confirmed 4 hours before departure is confirmed by the deadline and one confirmed 3 hours before departure is not; Premium Economy Select and Business Saver each state 3 hours, Economy Saver, Economy Classic and Economy Flex each state 2, and Basic Economy Lite states 0.

3. The settlement period is stated in business days: 5 business days under Business Flex, 7 under Business Saver, 10 under Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select alike, and 14 under Economy Saver and Economy Classic alike. Basic Economy Lite, under which no value is returned, is stated as 0.

4. Travel credit is the form of return under Economy Saver and Economy Classic although the unflown ticket is not refundable under either; the four brands that are refundable return value in the original form of payment.
